entries.name: Thomas Van Roland

expected_cases.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record

case.charges: Sit-in protesting segregated service at Shells City supermarket, Miami
case.sentence: Held in Dade County jail after the August 17, 1960 sit-in. James R. Robinson individually names him among seven who remained jailed until the August 26 trial, describing ten days in custody. Judge George Schulz imposed suspended sentences, and the group was picketing again the next day. Release is recorded at August month precision; the ten-day total follows the contemporary firsthand account, which counts the arrest and trial days.

entries.rationale: CORE September1960 p3 firsthand account names seven held ten days August17 until August26 trial; suspended sentences and free to picket following day. Separate Miami custody absent from existing cases.

entries.name: Thomas Gaither

expected_cases.charges: Trespass — the January 31, 1961 sit-in at the McCrory's lunch counter in Rock Hill, South Carolina.
expected_cases.sentence: Sentenced February 1, 1961 to thirty days at hard labor or a $100 fine. Refused to pay and remained in custody after the January 31 arrest and overnight detention at Rock Hill jail. Served the sentence at York County Prison Farm and was released March 2, 1961. The prison-farm transfer did not begin a separate custody episode.
